quantum.label: Quantum pipeline (GAS -> constraint-preserving SQA)
quantum.algorithm: Grover Adaptive Search (statevector simulation) picks the servers to switch on; constraint-preserving simulated quantum annealing (path-integral Monte Carlo) places the VMs on them.
quantum.reference: Dürr & Høyer 1996, arXiv:quant-ph/9607014 (quantum minimum finding); Gilliam, Woerner & Gonciulea 2021, Quantum 5, 428 (Grover Adaptive Search); Hen & Spedalieri 2016, Phys. Rev. Applied 5, 034007 and Hen & Sarandy 2016, Phys. Rev. A 93, 062312 (constraint-preserving drivers); Martoňák, Santoro & Tosatti 2002, Phys. Rev. B 66, 094203 (path-integral SQA)

control.label: Classical control (GAS -> constraint-preserving SA)
control.algorithm: Same Stage 1 and the same moves and budget as the quantum pipeline, with classical simulated annealing in Stage 2.

exact_r1.label: Exact optimum R1 (MILP, real sizes)
exact_r1.algorithm: Mixed-integer linear program on the real VM sizes (SciPy HiGHS), proven optimal for the linear energy model; the reference every method is compared with.
exact_r1.reference: Huangfu & Hall 2018, Math. Prog. Comp. 10, 119 (HiGHS); Virtanen et al. 2020, Nature Methods 17, 261 (SciPy milp)

cs_firstfit.label: CloudSim FirstFit (next-fit)
cs_firstfit.algorithm: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0 built-in VmAllocationPolicyFirstFit, VMs in input order; it resumes at the last used host, so it behaves as circular next-fit.
cs_firstfit.reference: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0, VmAllocationPolicyFirstFit; Silva Filho et al. 2017, IFIP/IEEE IM (CloudSim Plus)

cs_bestfit.label: CloudSim BestFit
cs_bestfit.algorithm: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0 built-in VmAllocationPolicyBestFit (active host with the fewest free CPU units), VMs in input order.
cs_bestfit.reference: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0, VmAllocationPolicyBestFit; Silva Filho et al. 2017, IFIP/IEEE IM (CloudSim Plus)

cs_worstfit.label: CloudSim WorstFit (Simple)
cs_worstfit.algorithm: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0 built-in VmAllocationPolicySimple (active host with the most free CPU units), VMs in input order.
cs_worstfit.reference: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0, VmAllocationPolicySimple; Silva Filho et al. 2017, IFIP/IEEE IM (CloudSim Plus)

cs_roundrobin.label: CloudSim RoundRobin
cs_roundrobin.algorithm: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0 built-in VmAllocationPolicyRoundRobin, VMs in input order.
cs_roundrobin.reference: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0, VmAllocationPolicyRoundRobin; Silva Filho et al. 2017, IFIP/IEEE IM (CloudSim Plus)

cs_ffd.label: First-Fit Decreasing
cs_ffd.algorithm: Textbook first-fit (lowest-index host that fits) with VMs sorted by CPU size descending, run in CloudSim Plus.

cs_bfd.label: Best-Fit Decreasing
cs_bfd.algorithm: CloudSim Plus 8.0.0 built-in VmAllocationPolicyBestFit with VMs sorted by CPU size descending.

pabfd.label: PABFD (implemented per Beloglazov & Buyya 2012)
pabfd.algorithm: Power-Aware Best-Fit Decreasing: VMs by CPU descending, each to the host with the smallest power increase (SPEC curve; an empty host is off). Not built into CloudSim Plus 8; implemented on its allocation hook.
pabfd.reference: Beloglazov & Buyya 2012, Concurrency Computat.: Pract. Exper. 24(13), 1397 (PABFD)

notes: Everything quantum is simulated on a classical computer (statevector Grover Adaptive Search, path-integral Monte Carlo SQA); no quantum speed-up is claimed.
Stage 2 shows no SQA advantage over classical SA: the classical control was better on medium and large at both budgets, every seed (Step 2D.4).
Stage 1 on large_v2: 1053 GAS oracle calls + measurements vs 4096 exhaustive evaluations. At m = 8 (small, medium) GAS costs more than exhaustive (R7); on large it is 1,053 vs 4,096.
The constraint-preserving SQA (one-hot hopping driver) is not runnable on today's quantum annealers, which only offer a transverse-field driver.
Quantization loss on large_v2: the best placement of the quantized model (unit 0.0025 NCU) costs +6.473 % joules vs the real-size exact optimum R1, so a quantized optimum can still lose to R1.
